data_objects.name: mass_spectrometry_features
data_objects.meaning: Mass-spectrometry feature records with mass-to-charge and retention-time coordinates, library or standard identifications, and an importance score.
data_objects.notes: Identification fields can be blank when no corresponding annotation is supplied.

variables.name: #featureID
variables.meaning: Composite feature identifier formed from high-precision mass-to-charge and retention-time text.

variables.name: row m/z
variables.meaning: Observed mass-to-charge coordinate of the feature.

variables.name: row retention time
variables.meaning: Chromatographic retention-time coordinate of the feature in an unspecified time unit.

variables.name: LibraryID
variables.meaning: Library-based compound annotation or spectral-match description, when available.

variables.name: standard_indentification_level_1
variables.meaning: Level-1 standard compound-identification label, when available; source spelling is preserved.

variables.name: _feature_id
variables.meaning: Duplicate representation of the composite feature identifier in #featureID.

variables.name: importance.score
variables.meaning: Dimensionless feature-importance score from an undocumented scoring procedure.

structure.description: Each row represents one mass-spectrometry feature. #featureID and _feature_id are identical feature identifiers, while row ID is an alternative integer identifier.
Rows are ordered by descending importance.score; this ordering is a ranking, not a chromatographic or mass axis.

uncertainties: The retention-time unit and the instrument or acquisition convention for m/z are not supplied.
The importance-score method and the exact confidence distinction between library and level-1 standard identifications are undocumented.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
